source.published_design: 2 fixed sites, 2018-2019, April-July, 13-14 rounds per site per year, 1-km two-hour transects, same collector

gate_reason: The supplement is valid and contains dated individual Bombus-plant records, but the observed unique-date structure does not match the source-defined 13-14 sampling rounds per site-year. Treating capture-positive dates as the sampling frame would condition time-bin inclusion on observing Bombus. The original admission gate therefore fails before coordinate extraction.
robustness_challenge_effect: No source is added. Continue to candidate rank 3, Mahe restoration networks, under the frozen order.
claim_boundary: This is a sampling-frame identification failure, not evidence about Sicily breadth, synchrony, Bombus ecology or the primary NEE route.
